# benchmark-payment-delegation

> Ledger policy benchmark: spending caps, merchant allowlists, refunds, and disputes for a delegated card agent.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-payment-delegation
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-payment-delegation
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-payment-delegation

## Tasks

40 episode tasks. Tools: get_balance, search_merchants, purchase, refund, dispute, ask_owner.
Generate: `node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed 20261015` (public) or `--split hidden` for evaluation-only tasks.

## Grading

Deterministic ledger replay. See docs/grading.md. No LLM judge.

## Commands

CLI: list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, mcp.
Offline: `npx benchmark-payment-delegation run --provider mock --model offline`
Gate: `npm run ci:local` → artifacts/e2e-report.json
